name: Thái Nguyên

queries.query: Thai Nguyen Vietnam official cadastral map parcel land registration GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official Thái Nguyên provincial digital map, the provincial land-data procedure page, the national land-data map, and official provincial reports on cadastral mapping/database work. No anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry API response was verified.

queries.query: Thái Nguyên bản đồ địa chính thửa đất cơ sở dữ liệu đất đai Văn phòng đăng ký đất đai
queries.result: First-party Vietnamese results describe the provincial digital map and land-data system, state that the local land-registration office provides land information, and document ongoing/complete cadastral mapping and database work. The public map shell did not expose a safely usable anonymous parcel schema or bounded ID-plus-geometry response.

registryEvidence.custodian: Văn phòng đăng ký đất đai (Land Registration Office), Thái Nguyên provincial land administration; national custodian is the land-data center under the national land-registration/data authority.
registryEvidence.basis: The official provincial legal-support page states that local land information is provided by the Văn phòng đăng ký đất đai, or commune authorities from cadastral records where a local database is not yet built. Official provincial material also documents Thái Nguyên's cadastral mapping and land-database work. This evidences the custodian/procedure, not an open parcel download or public geometry API.

officialSources.observation: Official provincial instructions identify this as the Thái Nguyên digital map and describe selecting an administrative unit and viewing details; the article says land and other provincial data are being digitized and connected.
officialSources.scope: Public map viewer discovery only; no safe parcel ID/geometry response was verified.

officialSources.observation: Official provincial legal-support page describes requests through national/provincial portals and identifies the local Văn phòng đăng ký đất đai as the local land-information provider.
officialSources.scope: Administrative procedure/custodian evidence; no public parcel geometry.

officialSources.observation: Official provincial report says cadastral surveying and mapping was completed across the province's 92 communes/wards and discusses land-database completion; it also notes sensitive user/owner data is part of the system.
officialSources.scope: Provincial program status, not an anonymous parcel endpoint; unsafe personal fields were not requested.

officialSources.observation: Official national land-inventory/map application was reachable through discovery, but its inspected public shell did not provide a bounded anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response suitable for retention.
officialSources.scope: National land-data map; no sample retained.

source: Thái Nguyên provincial digital-map/provincial land-administration sources and Vietnam national land-data map

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Provincial cadastral mapping and land-data system with local land-registration-office procedure coverage.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No public anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response, schema, or CRS was verified for Thái Nguyên city.

remainingUncertainty: The provincial/local custodian and public map initiative are evidenced, but the public viewer could not be inspected to a usable anonymous parcel response in this environment. No exact-point hit/miss or map extent miss is used as evidence of citywide absence.
